full_sentence: Because the train was late, we missed the start of the film.
acceptable_variants: we arrived after the film had started.
we had to wait outside the cinema.

options.text: although we had already bought tickets.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals contrast, but the stem needs a result of the late train, not a contrast.

options.text: if we had been on time.
options.why_wrong: 'If' introduces a condition, not the result of the delay.

options.text: we missed the start of the film.

options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated fact and does not follow from the train being late.

explanation: After 'because', the first clause gives the cause, so the main clause must describe the result of that cause. Options that signal contrast or condition do not fit.
